# Whole Field — Homologia / Analogia

**Standing:** mature T09 Etymology whole-field. `HISTORY.md` remains the historical/philological carrier; this page governs how agreement, correspondence and proportion may be used across the essay's distinct registers.

## #0 — Distinct fields entering one comparison

<a id="why-this-field-exists"></a>
### Why this field exists

The essay moves among mathematics, Śaiva metaphysics, Jungian psychology, language, topology, music and technical computation. Without a disciplined relational vocabulary, similarity quickly becomes false identity. **Homologia / Analogia** provides the grammar by which forms can answer to one another while remaining source-distinct.

Historical Greek meanings and morphology belong to evidence registers **1–2** where documented in `HISTORY.md`. Canonical cross-register use is normally **3 Operational homology**.

The field has **two members**, Homologia and Analogia. Agreement, proportion and research boundary are three offices of their use; the boundary is the dyad's answerability to its objects. Writing the account in six positions unfolds that answerability without changing the field's cardinality. The historical development **returns-to** [Historical and Relational Branches](HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md), which **historicises** the terms while [the protected history](HISTORY.md) retains its learning and provenance office.

## #1 — What survives the crossing

<a id="operations"></a>
### Operations

### Homological agreement

Two fields are homological when a materially relevant **operation or relational structure** can be shown to correspond while each field retains its own object and evidence. A visual resemblance is insufficient. The comparison must state what is transformed, preserved, generated or returned in both cases.

Consumers include **A02 Copula**, **A12 Mono/Poly**, **A13 Dia/Syn**, **C06 Copula**, **C36 Complexio Oppositorum**, **C50 Dia/Syn**.

The agreement is made inspectable by recovering two complete movements. In each, identify the terms before the change, the act that changes their relation, and the resulting difference that remains available for return. The comparison then states which of these relations corresponds. A common result alone is insufficient: cancellation and recognition can both end with a word such as “one” while giving that one incompatible offices. Conversely, different visible results can carry the same operation of retaining provenance through transformation.

[A02 — Copula](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference.md) **defines** the identification-through-difference consumed here; [A12 — Mono/Poly](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md) **grounds** its whole/many asymmetry. [A13 — Dia/Syn](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md) **tests** the comparison at the act of accounting: the polar line keeps a common axis; cancellation loses it; the syn-ballic relation carries the terms and their inverse reading into the result. The Greek names give these operations a linguistic office. The native derivation supplies their formal relation before that naming.

The full authorial field **grounds** this crossing through [Taylor's theorem source](../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md): `/ = −/−` brackets the six determinations `0/1`, `?/!`, `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS`, `∞/dx`, and `1/0` makes the return-switch. Relation becomes conscious circumstance, question/assertion, energetic polarity, recurrence, personed context and differential exactness before turning toward its condition. The Being, Becoming and Knowing/unKnowing pairs cross the Essence, Constitution and Text-Texture folds; the sequence retains its inversions. A local comparison must locate itself in this movement. Taylor's `X/x` is determining capacity and its indefinite particular; a Jungian reading refracts that established operation and never supplies its notation.

[C06 — Copula](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C06-Copula-Identification-with-Difference.md) and [C50 — Dia/Syn](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C50-Dia-Syn.md) **extend** the distinction into reusable concepts. [C23 — Severance](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C23-Severance.md) and [C24 — Fusion](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C24-Fusion.md) **test** its two losses: separated terms become unanswerable to their relation, or merged terms cease to contribute their differences. Homological agreement requires enough articulation for either failure to be recognised.

The [ancient-philosophy development](../../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/ancient-philosophy/DEVELOPMENT.md#ancient-source-return) **historicises** agreement through materially different relations: B51’s opposed pulls sustain an instrument; Aristotle’s focal predicates refer differently to a primary term; distribution, rectification and exchange employ different measures; a reconstructed mechanism coordinates distinct cycles. Homological agreement at register 3 retains what each act preserves and changes. The modern tuning account’s comma remains distinct from the native octave-completing factor, and modern allusion or reconstruction remains distinct from the ancient witness. The comparison returns more exact terms rather than one timeless doctrine of harmony.

## #2 — Proportion, focal dependence and the qualifying respect

### Analogical proportion

Analogy relates different terms through a proportion, focal orientation or qualified respect without asserting univocal sameness. It is the natural Etymology office for **C63 Pros Hen / In Quantum**, where Aristotle and Eckhart remain source-distinct even though both can discipline cross-register predication.

Consumers include **A34 Idealism**, **A36 Integral Zero**, **C60 Idealism**, **C63 Pros Hen / In Quantum**, **C64 Paradox**.

[C63 — Pros Hen / In Quantum](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C63-Pros-Hen-In-Quantum-Focal-Return-Qualified-Predication.md) **defines** three distinct grammars within this office. Proportional analogy compares a relation between terms with another relation. Focal predication makes different senses intelligible through one primary reference. Qualified predication states precisely the respect in which an assertion holds. Their coordination is authorial; each keeps its own test.

C63's health example makes focality concrete. A person has health, a diet contributes to it, and a complexion indicates it. Contribution and indication are not interchangeable acts, although both point to health. “The just person insofar as just” performs a different restriction: predication through justice applies under that qualification, without certifying the person's every action. The first account orders several uses around a focus; the second identifies the respect of one use. The relation between these grammars is productive because their difference remains active.

[A34 — Order of Dependence](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) **extends** this precision into the Argued ontology **Subject/Consciousness → Mind/Objective Internality → Object**. Epistemic access through an image and ontological dependence upon its source have different directions. A comparison that preserves only the first would fail to carry A34's proposition. Historical sources can qualify an attribution without replacing this order with general uncertainty about representation. [A36 — Integral Zero](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) **extends** the same office into acquired return: the sign's accumulated symbolic life retains its exact mathematical work while opening relations that the first advent had not yet acquired.

The [mathematics development](../../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/mathematics/DEVELOPMENT.md) **historicises** changed permissions and retained conditions. Zero’s absorption forbids cancelling a zero factor; ordinal succession, mediant insertion and the empty product have different laws; alternation with a shift represents a square root of minus one; a lifted loop retains winding rather than every event of travel. Analogical proportion at register 3 makes their relation explicit without exchanging their objects. In particular, tuning a fifth-cycle and multiplying the native octave-completing factors are different operations. A later evaluation must carry the actual law, reference policy or comparison class on which its precision depends.

The [formal-limit dossier](../../dossiers/formal-limit.md#eckhart-qualified-predication) **qualifies** analogical proportion through the different continuations a limit permits. Russell’s formation rule requires repair; Gödel’s derivability result retains its specified theory and hypotheses; Wittgenstein’s elucidation concerns its use; Cusa’s approximation and Eckhart’s qualified predicate retain their theological respects. At register 3 the comparison names which operation reaches which limit and what remains possible afterwards. Their relation sharpens the native determining-act inquiry without converting distinct restrictions into one theorem or an unproved sentence into a warrant for faith.

## #3 — The claim that the comparison actually makes

### Research boundary

**C30 Psychoid Number** depends upon this field as a guardrail. Numerical, geometric or archetypal correspondences may be philosophically fertile while remaining only operational analogy until independent evidence raises their standing. Cross-domain recurrence is never a covert proof of common cause or common descent.

Here “raises their standing” concerns an additional historical or empirical claim, not a ladder on which operational homology must climb to become legitimate. [C30 — Psychoid Number](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C30-Psychoid-Number.md) **defines** an Offered inquiry into the efficacy of number across psychic and physical descriptions. Its formal identities remain exact; its historically situated Jung–Pauli questions remain source-specific; its computational extension must show what changes in an apparatus. Evidence for one office cannot silently settle another. The inquiry's value lies in the discriminating work it makes possible.

The preserved relation must therefore be named at the appropriate grain. A formal isomorphism requires specified objects, a map and the structure preserved. A symbolic interpretation requires the whole image's movement and the exact transformation consumed. A technical proposal requires an observable consequence that can distinguish the proposed operation from its absence. An agreement discovered at any of these grains can return a new question to the others without borrowing their authority.

### Evidence law

```text
same operation across fields
≠ common historical descent
≠ doctrinal identity
≠ causal proof
```

A relation may remain important at register **3** without being demoted. The discipline is not sceptical reduction; it protects the relation from claiming a kind of warrant it has not earned.

The [myth history](../../histories/encounters-and-transmissions/myth/DEVELOPMENT.md) **historicises** what a whole telling can change in its reception. Harmonia retains Fear and Panic in the genealogy; Homer’s capture ends in release upon contingent surety with payment unreported; the Huayan net supplies its own simile-limit; Nietzsche, Gebser and Taylor perform separately dated interpretive work. E5’s research boundary receives those distinctions at register 3. A narrative consequence can qualify the operation attributed to an image, while a shared net, numeral or family figure supplies no proof of common descent, one doctrine or a completed technical return.

The [Jung–Pauli dossier](../../dossiers/jung-pauli-psychoid.md) **historicises** comparison as a negotiation which changes its terms. Pauli’s 1953 demand for neutral language, Jung’s clarification of psychoid and his rejection of absorption into physics remain different positions; Pauli’s 1957 metric/topology objection qualifies the hyperspace image. Number as mathematical relation, measured quantity and dream figure keeps three different offices. E5’s research boundary returns those speaker, date and object distinctions at register 3. A corrected receiving account must alter its attribution and inference, while psychophysical efficacy remains its own Offered inquiry and empirical task.

The [psychology history](../../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/psychology/DEVELOPMENT.md) **historicises** the research boundary at register 3 through three source-distinct objects: Pauli’s mathematical dream, Lacan’s formal transmission and Taylor’s native X/x. ## #5→0 — An achieved comparison becomes a new participant

<a id="relational-growth"></a>
### Relational growth

Homologia and Analogia themselves can generate new distinctions. When a comparison reveals both correspondence and irreducible difference, the achieved relation becomes a **seed/new participant** for another inquiry. This is Relational Form Growth rather than forced synthesis.

[Relational Form Growth](../RELATIONAL-FORM-GROWTH.md) **defines** the return: an achieved relation enters the next inquiry whole, carrying its internal differences. No conjugate sextet is manufactured for E5, and `N / N′ → N+N′` remains distinct from `N → N×N`. Here the productive result is a better-articulated dyad. Agreement says which operation persists; proportion says how different terms can answer within a stated relation; the received result changes what must next be recovered from both fields.

The return has an exact consequence. A poem's aftermath can alter the analogy made from its opening. A mathematical hypothesis can narrow a proposed map while preserving the operation that first made the comparison useful. An apparatus that fails to change as predicted returns a failed implementation claim, not a refutation of every formal or symbolic proposition carried beside it. [Historical and Relational Branches](HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md#e5-branch-return) **returns-to** this field with these differences made explicit. Consumers return their own operation, consequence and remaining question; E5 receives the correction without acquiring their authority.

**Standing:** the comparative grammar is Argued; native derivations retain their individually declared standing; C30 remains Offered and empirical efficacy remains Open where untested. Greek word history, Aristotle, Eckhart and Owen retain separate source tasks. The companion distinguishes bounded research verification from canonical source admission and quotation readiness. These pages do not certify reciprocal consumer closure.

The [indra net whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/chinese-huayan/indra-net/WHOLE.md#indra-simile-and-distinctness) **qualifies** comparison at register 3. Homological agreement specifies a local member disclosing its constitutive relations; analogical proportion keeps the jewels’ images distinct from the phenomena they figure. The source’s closing qualification lets the comparison state where its material ceases to carry the relation. Applying that qualification to this field remains an Offered authorial comparison; recurrence supplies no historical descent or common physical cause.

The [antikythera attunement whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/antikythera-attunement/WHOLE.md#antikythera-native-archetypal-return) **qualifies** the register-3 crossing by preserving a differentiated form’s capacity to carry a wider relation through finite operation. Homological agreement names that retained operation; analogical proportion distinguishes astronomical cycle, archaeological model, psychic refraction and native derivation. The research boundary keeps the reconstructed dial from proving QL or supplying its makers with a contemporary doctrine.
